couch.name: Grand Victorian Sofa
couch.description: An exquisite specimen of late-nineteenth-century craftsmanship, featuring hand-carved mahogany scrollwork and original tufted silk upholstery.

table.name: Regency-Style Armchair
table.description: An elegant drawing-room armchair displaying characteristic neoclassical lines, fluted legs, and rich gold-leaf accents.

potted plant.name: Fiddle Leaf Fig
potted plant.description: A vibrant Ficus Lyrata, commonly known as a Fiddle Leaf Fig. This specimen is a staple of modern interior design, known for its sculptural violin-shaped leaves and clean architectural silhouette.
